SCORE: the board rank follows Shop ALL = 0.5 Book + 0.3 revenue + 0.2 stars, each a percentile among shops (Round 3 rule; Round 4 shows ranks only). Book = balance - 5,000,000 + cost of unsold stock. So: (1) revenue is 30% and a shop with 0 revenue ties for last there; every settle moves us up; (2) storage (0.5%/h of cost) and expired food lower Book: hold lots of 2-5 that sell within a day, never let food expire (sell it at the median -3% the day before); (3) a sale below cost lowers Book only by the loss, much less than the stock spoiling; (4) stars come from buyers: state grade and shelf life exactly as GET /api/inventory shows.
